author: kon333
body:
Hey this is a map I made with FlashFireK,  _Spazz_ and UneCookie. Thanks to AlexanderJoe for his server.

Info

  • It is Destroy The Monument.
  • 2 teams of 16 players.
  • Team Colours are Pink and Purple
  • No download yet 
  • XML is done by Prodigy :D Thanks prod!
  • Its got tunnels, OP sword, 4 monuments and lots of lava!

Album:

http://imgur.com/a/fanL1

XML:

http://github.com/prodigy4532/prodigy4532XML/blob/master/Avicus/XML/DTM/Ignicia.xml



Please could you leave feedback in the comment section.

Thanks for your time

P.S:    sorry if this is not how you present map releases it is my first time doing this.


Edited: If you would like to see more images of the map just comment because i took lots of screenshots at revealing bits of the map you dont really see from the first pictures :)  Also the name of the map may seem weird but it "Ignis" is the latin word for Fire!

replies.author: PieZ
replies.body:
This map has been denied by the map developers for the following reasons.

-Awkward shaping: This map looks like a challenge to start bridging because of how open the map is and the monument places are. 

-Monument places: Push them back a bit. It seems like an easy way to get monuments for attacks and a hard way for people to defend. 

You may submit this map again once you made these edits.
